create_runtime_params: create a RuntimeParams dataclass with pedestal electron density, ion and electron temperatures, and rho norm top
build_pedestal_model: build a SetTemperatureDensityPedestalModel that directly specifies pedestal temperature and density profiles
run_pedestal_model: run the SetTemperatureDensityPedestalModel to compute pedestal outputs from runtime params, geometry, and core profiles
test_runtime_params: test the RuntimeParams dataclass fields including n_e_ped, T_i_ped, T_e_ped, rho_norm_ped_top, and n_e_ped_is_fGW
review_call_implementation: review the _call_implementation method that converts pedestal top to nearest cell index and calculates n_e_ped with optional Greenwald fraction conversion
